name: liquid-glass
title: Liquid Glass Card
description: A translucent rounded card sits on a coloured background and blurs whatever shows through it, with bright inner edges and a soft outer halo. It can be picked up and dragged, and it lifts a little on hover.
use: You want a translucent panel that keeps a vivid background visible behind the content it holds.
avoid: Backdrop blur and the SVG distortion are costly on weak devices, and glass needs a colourful backdrop to read.
a11y: Drag is pointer-only with no keyboard path, and nothing announces the card's purpose to screen readers. (keyboard: no, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A rounded frosted rectangle, about a sixth of the frame, resting on an indigo-to-pink gradient. White text reads a big temperature, a condition and a city, with a faint hint line below. Its edges catch a thin white highlight and a soft glow spreads outside.
behaves: The pane can be grabbed and dragged; letting go lets it spring back with a slight bounce. Hovering enlarges it a fraction and pressing shrinks it briefly. Content inside stays sharp while the area behind is blurred.
customise: Blur, shadow, glow and radius each take a named size or value prop, plus draggable and expandable toggles and width props. The inner content is whatever children you pass.
weight: moderate: Backdrop blur plus an SVG displacement filter run over a draggable animated node.
demo: A weather readout: 24°C, Partly Cloudy, San Francisco, CA, and the hint Drag me · Hover to glow.
issues: The bottom hint line at 60% white is barely readable against the bright gradient.
polishWhy: Layered glass edges and a believable glow; the inner hint text is very faint.
